summary: Phase 1 step 2 of the Challenge Roadmap is done: protocol draft v0.1 (docs/development/challenge_pipeline/PROTOCOL_DRAFT.md) defines the four stages (entry, work, Graphite, output, exit) with battery as the worked example, the freeze and stop rules, the stage-output templates (challenge brief, design packet, frozen evidence record) and Graphite's per-stage permission ledger as data in Graphite's own role names (the frozen run admits none; ranking only the writer). It reuses the admission protocol's tracks, frozen study sheet and evidence package. Battery's gaps are named: no p50/p95 on reference hardware, no registered anchor set, disclosure budget or sealed pool, no direct-solver, interpolation or reduced-order baselines, EV3 not run, no graded suite. Wiring the ledger into the controller is step 3 harness work. Every value set during battery stays HUMAN_INPUT with its proposer and approver named; the reference timing hardware is a recommendation (a pinned RunPod CPU pod). DRAFT until the process owner locks the protocol.
